# Let me re-do the convex hull outline properly with value 2
from scipy.spatial import ConvexHull
import numpy as np

height, width = 14, 17
grid = np.zeros((height, width), dtype=int)
points = [(3, 6), (6, 4), (8, 1), (8, 12), (10, 10), (12, 8)]

rh = np.array([list(p) for p in points]).astype(float)
hull = ConvexHull(rh)
vertices = rh[hull.vertices]

n = len(vertices)
for i in range(n):
    p1 = vertices[i]
    p2 = vertices[(i + 1) % n]
    r1, c1 = int(round(p1[0])), int(round(p1[1]))
    r2, c2 = int(round(p2[0])), int(round(p2[1]))
    
    num_points = max(abs(r2 - r1), abs(c2 - c1)) + 1
    rr = np.linspace(r1, r2, num_points).astype(int)
    cc = np.linspace(c1, c2, num_points).astype(int)
    
    for r, c in zip(rr, cc):
        if 0 <= r < height and 0 <= c < width:
            grid[r, c] = 2

grid_list = [list(row) for row in grid]
print("Convex hull outline with value 2:")
for row in grid_list:
    print(row)
